ev.q: The player can travel with up to two party members at a time
Particular praise was given to the character of Kreia
The player makes choices that turn the Exile to either the light side or the dark side
praise was given to the story, characters, and writing
Like its predecessor, it is set in the Star Wars universe
The player can use a variety of melee and ranged weapons, including swords and firearms
The game starts with a character creation screen with several choices to make
add-ons to the Jedi classes that were established in Knights of the Old Republic
There are 30 new Force powers, which are manifestations of the Force
Players can loot corpses and various environmental objects
as well as being launched in an incomplete state
